name: Yuru Fuwa Mama wa, Beach de Charao ni Nanpasaremashita ~Musuko ga Ita Kedo Kotowarenakute♪~
original_name: ゆるふわママは、ビーチでチャラ男にナンパされました ～息子がいたけど断れなくて♪～
source:
"Mom guess what!"

I won a pair of tickets to a ryokan (Japanese-style inn) on the beach. My mother was excited, but I was a little reluctant. 

My mother is so young looking that I can hardly believe she is thirty-eight years old. And she is attractive, which is strange for me, her son, to say. However, she has a gentle personality and is easily swayed. When she is forced to do something, it is often difficult for her to refuse. 

Going to the beach with my mother is not a bad idea, but I need to get my act together.

And then, I went to the beach with my mother. I was at the beach with my mother, and when I took my eyes off her for a moment, men started doing whatever they wanted to her.

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt274/apt274.html#link_story] official site[/url]]
translation:
“妈妈你猜怎么着！”

我赢得了两张海滩上的日式旅馆的门票。妈妈很兴奋，我却有些不舍。

我的母亲看起来很年轻，我简直不敢相信她已经三十八岁了。她很有吸引力，这对我这个她的儿子来说很奇怪。但她性格温柔，很容易动摇。当她被迫做某事时，她往往很难拒绝。

和妈妈一起去海滩不是一个坏主意，但我需要振作起来。

然后，我就和妈妈一起去了海边。我和母亲在海滩上，当我把目光从她身上移开一会儿时，男人们开始对她为所欲为。
